Aisha K.: Hey team — joining from UK, passport is in for renewal and won't arrive before my start date (4/1). I saw I-9 needs document verification. What should I do for day 1?
people-ops: Welcome Aisha :) short answer: we can still complete Section 2 using an authorized representative or do an in-person verification on day 1. We'll need acceptable docs (List A OR List B + List C). Can you confirm what you currently have? passport/driving license/SSN card?
lina (HR Ops): If your passport is pending, common workaround is a gov photo ID (current) + SSN card (or a certified letter from SSA). For non-US citizens, work authorization docs (EAD, I-94) work as List A. If you don't have SSN yet, we'll use whatever shows work authorization.
Aisha K.: I only have my expired passport (expired last month) and a UK driver's license, I applied for renewal but won't get it until mid-April. I do have my SSN card.
people-ops: OK. Expired passports generally aren't acceptable. But driver’s license (List B) + SSN card (List C) is valid. We'll need originals for inspection. Since you're remote, options: 1) we mail a courier to inspect originals on day 1 (no copies stored), 2) you bring originals to a local certified agent (notary) and they sign the I-9 as our authorized rep, or 3) come to our office on day 1 if feasible.
Aisha K.: Courier sounds easiest. How does that book / what time?
mateo (IT): tagging @people-ops — I can book laptop delivery + courier I-9 inspection together. Courier windows are 9-11 or 1-3. Which do you prefer? Also will need a photo for badge.
Aisha K.: 9-11 works for me. Can we do badge pic at same time?
it-courier-bot: Booking attempt: /book-courier --date 2026-04-01 --window 09:00-11:00 --services i9-verification,laptop-delivery,badge-photo
it-courier-bot: Booking confirmed. Reference: CR-20260401-9182 (ETA: 09:30).
people-ops: Great — we'll use the courier option then. Aisha, please upload a front/back photo of your SSN card and your driver's license to the secure portal so we have a preliminary copy for HR intake (we do NOT accept these as verification; courier will inspect originals). Link: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/upload (use your invite token).
Aisha K.: Uploaded now. Thanks!
lina (HR Ops): Two quick notes: 1) Background check vendor may still be pending if passport stamps needed; we'll give conditional access until BG clears. 2) Benefits enrollment: please complete within 30 days of start — portal link is https://redwood.example.com/benefits. Day-1 orientation schedule: 10:00 intro w/people-ops, 11:00 manager welcome + engineering team sync, 14:00 benefits walkthrough.
mateo (IT): Laptop image + VPN will be prepped; I'll DM you the temp credentials after courier handoff.
Aisha K.: Perfect — see you all 4/1. Thanks for the quick help :raised_hands:
people-ops: Awesome. I'll update the onboarding checklist and mark "I-9 scheduled via courier". If anything changes pls ping in this thread. :thumbsup:
